W.example_chinese: 醒醒！该上学了。

W.example: I walk to work every day.
W.example_chinese: 我每天步行去上班。

W.example: Walking is good exercise for people of all ages.
W.example_chinese: 步行对所有年龄段的人都是很好的锻炼。

W.example: There's a picture hanging on the wall.
W.example_chinese: 墙上挂着一幅画。

W.example: I keep my money and credit cards in my wallet.
W.example_chinese: 我把钱和信用卡放在钱包里。

W.example: I want to learn how to play the guitar.
W.example_chinese: 我想学弹吉他。

W.example: It's warm outside - you don't need a jacket.
W.example_chinese: 外面很暖和——你不需要夹克。

W.example: I need to wash my car this weekend.
W.example_chinese: 我这个周末需要洗车。

W.example: After dinner, I need to wash up.
W.example_chinese: 晚饭后，我需要洗碗。

W.example: Put your dirty clothes in the washing machine.
W.example_chinese: 把你的脏衣服放进洗衣机里。

W.example: It's your turn to do the washing-up tonight.
W.example_chinese: 今晚轮到你洗碗了。

W.example: My watch says it's 3 o'clock. (n) / Let's watch a movie tonight. (v)
W.example_chinese: 我的手表显示是3点钟。(n) / 我们今晚看电影吧。(v)

W.example: Drink plenty of water when it's hot.
W.example_chinese: 天气热的时候要多喝水。

W.example: Can you tell me the way to the station? / There's more than one way to solve this problem.
W.example_chinese: 你能告诉我去车站的路吗？/ 解决这个问题的方法不止一种。

W.example: We are going on holiday next week.
W.example_chinese: 我们下周要去度假。

W.example: What are you going to wear to the party?
W.example_chinese: 你打算穿什么去参加聚会？

W.example: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
W.example_chinese: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

W.example: Spiders spin webs to catch insects.
W.example_chinese: 蜘蛛织网捕捉昆虫。

W.example: I found the information on a web page.
W.example_chinese: 我在一个网页上找到了这个信息。

W.example: Visit our website for more details.
W.example_chinese: 访问我们的网站获取更多详情。

W.example: There are seven days in a week.
W.example_chinese: 一周有七天。

W.example: I work from Monday to Friday, so those are my weekdays.
W.example_chinese: 我从周一到周五工作，所以那些是我的工作日。

W.example: We usually relax at home on the weekend.
W.example_chinese: 我们通常在周末在家放松。

W.example: I get a weekly magazine. (adj) / The cleaning service comes weekly. (adv)
W.example_chinese: 我每周收到一本杂志。(adj) / 清洁服务每周来一次。(adv)

W.example: You're welcome to use my computer. (adj) / Welcome to our home! (exclam)
W.example_chinese: 欢迎你使用我的电脑。(adj) / 欢迎来到我们家！(exclam)

W.chinese: 健康；良好；很好地；合适地
W.example: I hope you get well soon. (adj) / She speaks English very well. (adv)
W.example_chinese: 我希望你早日康复。(adj) / 她英语说得很好。(adv)

W.example: He is a well-known actor in our country.
W.example_chinese: 他是我们国家著名的演员。

W.chinese: 西；西方；西方的；向西方；在西方
W.example: The sun sets in the west. (n) / We drove west for two hours. (adv)
W.example_chinese: 太阳在西边落下。(n) / 我们向西行驶了两个小时。(adv)

W.example: My clothes got wet in the rain.
W.example_chinese: 我的衣服在雨中淋湿了。

W.example: What time is it? (det) / What is your name? (pron)
W.example_chinese: 现在几点了？(det) / 你叫什么名字？(pron)

W.example: The front wheel of my bicycle is flat.
W.example_chinese: 我自行车的前轮没气了。

W.example: When are you coming to visit?
W.example_chinese: 你什么时候来拜访？

W.example: Where do you live?
W.example_chinese: 你住在哪里？

W.example: Which book do you want to read? (det) / Which is your bag? (pron)
W.example_chinese: 你想读哪本书？(det) / 哪个是你的包？(pron)

W.example: I'll cook dinner while you set the table.
W.example_chinese: 你摆餐桌的时候我来做晚饭。

W.example: She wore a white dress to the wedding.
W.example_chinese: 她穿了一件白色的连衣裙去参加婚礼。

W.example: Who is that man over there?
W.example_chinese: 那边那个人是谁？

W.example: I ate the whole pizza by myself. (adj) / The whole of the country celebrated the victory. (n)
W.example_chinese: 我一个人吃了整个披萨。(adj) / 整个国家都庆祝胜利。(n)

W.example: Whose pen is this?
W.example_chinese: 这是谁的钢笔？

W.example: Why are you late?
W.example_chinese: 你为什么迟到？

W.example: The river is very wide at this point.
W.example_chinese: 河流在这段非常宽。

W.example: My wife and I have been married for ten years.
W.example_chinese: 我和我的妻子已经结婚十年了。

W.example: We saw wild animals on our safari trip.
W.example_chinese: 我们在狩猎旅行中看到了野生动物。

W.example: I will call you tomorrow.
W.example_chinese: 我明天会给你打电话。

W.example: I hope our team wins the game.
W.example_chinese: 我希望我们队赢得比赛。

W.example: The wind is very strong today.
W.example_chinese: 今天风很大。

W.example: Please close the window - it's cold outside.
W.example_chinese: 请关上窗户——外面很冷。

W.example: Windsurfing is a popular water sport in coastal areas.
W.example_chinese: 帆板运动是沿海地区流行的水上运动。

W.example: It's too windy to have a picnic today.
W.example_chinese: 今天风太大，不适合野餐。

W.example: The winner of the competition will receive a prize.
W.example_chinese: 比赛的获胜者将获得奖品。

W.example: We usually go skiing in the winter.
W.example_chinese: 我们通常在冬天去滑雪。

W.example: Make a wish before you blow out the candles.
W.example_chinese: 吹灭蜡烛前许个愿。

W.example: I'm going to the cinema with my friends.
W.example_chinese: 我要和朋友们一起去看电影。

W.example: I can't make this recipe without eggs.
W.example_chinese: 没有鸡蛋我做不了这个食谱。

W.example: She is a very intelligent woman.
W.example_chinese: 她是一个非常聪明的女人。

W.example: We had a wonderful time on our holiday.
W.example_chinese: 我们假期过得很愉快。

W.example: This table is made of solid wood.
W.example_chinese: 这张桌子是实木做的。

W.example: We have wooden floors in our house.
W.example_chinese: 我们房子里有木地板。

W.example: I have a lot of work to do today. (n) / She works in a bank. (v)
W.example_chinese: 我今天有很多工作要做。(n) / 她在银行工作。(v)

W.example: The factory employs over 500 workers.
W.example_chinese: 这家工厂雇佣了500多名工人。

W.example: I would like to travel around the world.
W.example_chinese: 我想环游世界。

W.example: I'm worried about my exam results.
W.example_chinese: 我担心我的考试成绩。

W.example: Don't worry about the small things.
W.example_chinese: 别为小事担心。

W.example: My cold is worse today than yesterday.
W.example_chinese: 我今天感冒比昨天更严重了。

W.example: That was the worst movie I've ever seen.
W.example_chinese: 那是我看过的最糟糕的电影。

W.example: I would like a cup of tea, please.
W.example_chinese: 请给我来杯茶。

W.example: Wow! That's an amazing view!
W.example_chinese: 哇！那景色太棒了！

W.example: Please write your name at the top of the page.
W.example_chinese: 请在页面顶部写下你的名字。

W.example: Write down the important points from the lecture.
W.example_chinese: 记下讲座中的要点。

W.example: She is a famous writer of children's books.
W.example_chinese: 她是著名的儿童书籍作家。

W.example: His writing is difficult to read.
W.example_chinese: 他的字迹很难辨认。

W.example: You have the wrong number.
W.example_chinese: 你打错电话了。

X.example: We always have a big family dinner on Xmas day.
X.example_chinese: 我们总是在圣诞节那天吃一顿丰盛的家庭晚餐。

X.example: The doctor ordered an X-ray of my chest to check for problems.
X.example_chinese: 医生让我拍胸部X光片检查问题。

Y.example: I've been studying English for three years.
She was wearing a bright yellow dress.
Y.example_chinese: 她穿了一件亮黄色的连衣裙。

Y.example: Yes, I would like some coffee.
Yesterday was a beautiful day. (n) / I saw him yesterday. (adv)
Y.example_chinese: 昨天是个美好的一天。(n) / 我昨天看见他了。(adv)

Y.example: Have you finished your homework yet?
I eat yoghurt with fruit for breakfast.
She looks very young for her age.
Y.example_chinese: 她看起来比实际年龄年轻很多。

Y.example: Is this your book? (det) / Your is the red one. (pron)
Y.example_chinese: 这是你的书吗？(det) / 你的是红色的那个。(pron)
请你们自己再拿些食物。

Y.example: He spent his youth in a small village.
Y.example_chinese: 他在一个小村庄度过了他的青年时期。

Z.example: Zebras have black and white stripes.
The temperature dropped to zero degrees last night.
The zip on my jacket is broken. (n) / Can you help me zip up my dress? (v)
Z.example_chinese: 我夹克上的拉链坏了。(n) / 你能帮我拉上连衣裙的拉链吗？(v)

Z.example: We took the children to the zoo to see the animals.
Z.example_chinese: 我们带孩子们去动物园看动物。
